---
title: "Troubleshooting"
description: "Fixes for common problems and error messages."
---

Before anything else, check the version in the window title (for example **v1.0**) against the newest one on the [Releases page](https://github.com/pbeens/Petes-PDF-to-MD/releases). Many problems are already fixed in a later build.

## The app won't open: "Apple could not verify…"

The app isn't registered with Apple, so macOS blocks it the first time. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway** next to the message about Pete's PDF to MD. See [Getting started, step 1](getting-started.qmd#step-1-download-and-install-the-app).

## The outline is flat or has odd headings

- If the PDF has bookmarks, the app trusts them. A PDF whose bookmarks are incomplete gives an incomplete outline.
- Turn on *Include section info in files* and check the `Source` line to see which method was used. [How it works](how-it-works.qmd#finding-the-headings) explains the three methods.

## Scanned PDFs {#scanned-pdfs}

If a section is empty or reads *(No extractable text in this range.)*, or the app warns that many pages are *images with no text*, the pages are pictures with no text layer. Run the PDF through a text-recognition (OCR) tool first, for example **Adobe Acrobat → Scan & OCR**, then convert the result.

A PDF that has already been through OCR, or slides exported as pictures with their text kept in a hidden layer, converts directly: the app reads the hidden layer and says so in the status line.

## I used an older version that needed Python

Version 1.0 doesn't need Python or its PyMuPDF and pdf-inspector add-ons (everything it needs is built in), and no longer shows the "PyMuPDF is not installed" or "no table detection" messages. If you see them, you're still running version 0.8 or earlier: download 1.0 from the [Releases page](https://github.com/pbeens/Petes-PDF-to-MD/releases) and replace the app in Applications.

## "Conversion failed … invalid/corrupt PDF"

The file may be damaged, incomplete, or not really a PDF. Open it in Preview or Acrobat, save or export it as a new PDF, and convert that copy.

## "Conversion failed … Output files are locked by another program"

A file from the previous conversion is open in another program, so it can't be replaced. Close any open section files, previews or editors, and run the conversion again.

## "Could not open output folder … Output directory not found"

The output folder doesn't exist yet. Click **Change** next to *Output Root*, choose a folder, and run the conversion once.

## Still stuck?

Use **Support → Report a Bug** in the app, or [open an issue on GitHub](https://github.com/pbeens/Petes-PDF-to-MD/issues). Include the full version from the window title, what you did, and the exact message. If you can share the PDF, attach it or say where it can be downloaded.
